O1.title: Two-track provenance policy and rights-reviewed acquired-fixture pilot
verified_facts: M1 explicitly requires actual generator/version/license provenance, but does not name historical writer executable hashes.
B01-W specifies exact executable/package/argv binding for its proposed new-generation campaign.
Debian manifests assign file-path coverage, and rarfile contribution history aligns with named package author.
hypotheses: Fixed immutable bytes can serve a differential replay experiment without the original writer binary.
DRF-OLD/DRF-SOLID/DRF-VOL could become suitable small pilot inputs after rights and native qualification.
proposed_policy_changes: Explicit acquired-immutable class permits null unknown historical writer/version/hash with reason; generated-reproducible class retains prospective writer records.
Human-approved M1/B01 evidence requirement amendment and any B01-W recipe substitution; reviewed manifest validator extension, not implicit null acceptance.
O1.effort: Estimate only: 1-2 engineer-days policy/rights review; 3-5 engineer-days small pilot/native captures if harness reusable; elapsed/CI time uncertain.
risks: License path coverage does not establish exact member/source authority.
Unknown writer prevents named-writer interoperability claims and regeneration.
Metadata/test labels cannot replace native method evidence; missing other B01 requirements remain.
O1.human_decision_needed: Approve precise replay evidence-policy amendment; separately resolve exact rights and authorize finite acquisition/import pilot.
O1.next_action: Original B01 reviews DRF-OLD, DRF-SOLID, DRF-VOL rights under proposed policy; acquire only after explicit clearance, hash/quarantine and capture native results additively.
O1.stop_condition: Stop at three DRF families or unresolved rights, source/byte mismatch, unsafe resource demand, semantic disagreement; no automatic further search.

O2.title: One narrow inquiry or voluntary licensed contribution round
verified_facts: Current task authorizes drafting, not external correspondence or execution.
No fixture-specific complete container/member grant was established in inspected materials.
hypotheses: A maintainer or contributor may confirm exact existing grants or contribute independently rights-cleared bytes.
Newly licensed contributions could eventually target every original B01-W case; no donor or suitable generation route is established.
proposed_policy_changes: Human approval for at most two recipients, one message and one clarification, 14-calendar-day window.
If original writer metadata remains unknown, O1 evidence-class decision is additionally necessary; otherwise existing strict requirements continue.
O2.effort: Estimate only: 0.5-1 engineer-day preparation/review; external response within proposed 14-day bound unknown; later native work separate.
risks: Contributor may lack authority for borrowed members/container.
A reply is not native qualification or operator proprietary execution permission.
Fresh generation may remain infeasible under the no-commercial constraint.
O2.human_decision_needed: Approve exact unsent inquiry/recipients and rights-assessment process; no paid/trial/commercial generation commission.
O2.next_action: After approval, request exact grant scope, member authorship/source, unknown historical metadata and immutable binding; use the report donation manifest.
O2.stop_condition: One round only; stop after 14 days, unresolved authority, incompatible terms or commercial execution request; record outcome and choose another explicit path.

O3.title: Explicit qualification/dependency partition with closed unqualified RAR surface
verified_facts: Reviewed M3 directly gates B05/S2a/S3/S5 on B01 and public engine exposure on B08.
M2 permits opt-in incremental surface and forbids destructive double-execution fallback.
Q1/S1 and independent B02/B03/B04 lanes have their own prerequisites, not all directly B01-dependent.
hypotheses: A bounded non-RAR opt-in surface can advance with separately qualified relevant prerequisites and pre-dispatch exclusion.
proposed_policy_changes: Separate human-approved operation-format-platform qualification scopes and corresponding DAG contracts; never mark/ archive B01 done to satisfy dependencies.
Narrower preview/new-surface promise, not full parity; no codec or Qt architecture substitution.
O3.effort: Estimate only: 1-2 engineer-days partition specification/review; gate enforcement, implementation and native qualification effort unknown.
risks: Deleting B01/B05 edges without replacement loses shared error/password/lifetime prerequisites.
Users may mistake legacy availability for new-app parity; no after-write automatic fallback.
O3.human_decision_needed: Approve narrower opt-in scope and separate graph/spec review; earlier full acceptance decision is not implicitly superseded.
O3.next_action: Orchestrator/architect propose an exact allowlist, remaining dependency owners, pre-dispatch enforcement tests and legacy preselection; change no graph on this report.
O3.stop_condition: Stop if exclusion cannot precede probing/writing, or full replacement parity is required now; retain current graph and corpus path.
